independentDerivationAndChecks: A column copied at rowt has last recomputation r<t with val>=r but copied at r+1 means val<r+1, hence label r. P07makes r blocker; COPY keeps it forever. Conversely every blocker p<t occupies its unique victim. Thus frozen label count A(t-1), and no diagonal ghost can freeze.

Overlap ledger gives I=2t+1-d-H; subtract young ghost count for G4. The previous block on columns<=t-4 equals old block<=t-5 plus age3ghost, with no lost threshold ghost label t-1 because such label would be a blocker. Thus G4p=G4(t-1)+ygh3(t-1). Subtract row ledgers and use ygh(t-1)-ygh3=ygh2p to obtain first formula.
Row partition has A(t-1)frozen, I ghosts, pool, own diagonal, total t+1. Hence pool=t-A(t-1)-I. Substitute b_t=A(t)-A(t-1) and I=2t+1-d-H into I-pool+b_t-2+2H to obtain3t+A(t)-2d exactly.

Pool also equals A(d(t)-1)-A(t-1)+F_t by P11 and maximality. The definitional changes dG4versus Delta G cannot be dropped, and young indicator identities do not by themselves imply global density/sublinear Q. All finite corroboration outside flat data range is excluded from this proof.
